subject: Temporary quota rescue + discount ladder proposal
messages:
From: Grace Lin <ops@averyapps.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc:  
Date: 2027-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Production spike — immediate quota increase request

Connor —

Quick note: we pushed a small feature last night and saw an unexpected 8x spike in inference volume this morning. Our app is throttling customer-facing requests; we need a short-term increase to avoid user-impact while we roll a fix.

Can Redwood temporarily raise our QPS/throughput by ~5x for the next 72 hours? We can accept a short-term surcharge or credits but need it live within the hour if possible. Attached is a one-page usage export and the error traces.

We’re happy to align on a mid-term plan (commit bump or discount ladder) if we stabilize usage.

—Grace
Ops Lead, Avery Apps
attachments: avery-usage-Apr-10.csv (csv), error-traces.txt (txt)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Grace Lin <ops@averyapps.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>; Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T09:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production spike — immediate quota increase request

On 2027-04-11 09:12 AM PDT, Grace Lin wrote:
> Connor —
>
> Quick note: we pushed a small feature last night and saw an unexpected 8x spike in inference volume this morning...

Grace — thanks for the heads up and the usage file. We can do an emergency, provisional quota rescue to get you back to normal while you mitigate.

Proposal (immediate):
- Temporary throughput lift: +500% cap for 72 hours, active now.
- Surcharge: +30% on per-token charges for any consumption beyond the existing committed threshold during the rescue window.
- If you want credits instead of surcharge, we can apply a one-time usage credit equal to 70% of the overrun bill instead of the surcharge, provided a signed PO arrives within 5 business days.

Longer-term options we can discuss next week: commit uplift (3–12 month tiers), or a declining discount ladder based on sustained monthly spend (details below). Ben and Laura are looped to comment on commercial approvals and PO flow.

Can you confirm: (1) do you want the surcharge or the credit path? (2) confirm the start-of-rescue window (I’ve tentatively enabled it at 09:30 PDT).

I’ll stand by and can escalate for more headroom if needed.

—Connor
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production spike — immediate quota increase request

Connor —

Good call activating the rescue. A few internal notes on authority and the discount ladder:
- I can approve a one-off surcharge up to 40% for emergency windows. Anything above that or multi-week credits needs manager sign-off.
- Suggest offering the one-time credit option to Avery (70% credit on the overrun) as your note says, but include a clear PO signature deadline (5 business days) and a small Advance Payment holdback (10% of projected overrun) to mitigate non-payment risk.
- For the longer-term bucket: propose a 3-tier discount ladder tied to monthly committed tokens:
  * Tier A: 10% off list at >= $50k/mo
  * Tier B: 18% off list at >= $150k/mo
  * Tier C: 25% off list at >= $350k/mo
Include a 60-day lookback for sustained usage to qualify them.

Laura — please prep a short term-sheet we can send to Avery that includes the rescue window terms, surcharge vs credit checkbox, PO instructions, and the discount ladder summary. I’ve put a soft deal id on this: RDW-AVY-2027-Q2-089.

—Ben
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Grace Lin <ops@averyapps.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T11:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production spike — immediate quota increase request

Connor / Ben —

Thanks — the rescue is live and we see fewer throttles immediately, appreciate the fast response.

We’ll take the credit path (70% one-time credit) and will get a signed PO over within 48 hours. Grace to loop finance to expedite. Two quick clarifications: (1) will the temporary uplift auto-roll back after 72 hours or do we need an explicit revert? (2) can we get a one-page breakdown of how the surcharge vs credit amounts are calculated so we can include it in our PO?

Also, if this pattern continues, we’d be open to the Tier A commit test for a month and then revisit the ladder.

—Grace
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Grace Lin <ops@averyapps.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>; Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-14T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production spike — immediate quota increase request

Grace —

Confirmed: rescue window is scheduled to auto-revert at 09:30 PDT on 2027-04-14 unless you tell us to extend. I’m attaching the short term-sheet and a worked example of the credit calculation for the overrun so you can copy it into your PO.

Key items in the attached term-sheet (rescue-term-sheet.pdf):
- Rescue window: 2027-04-11 09:30 PDT to 2027-04-14 09:30 PDT (auto-revert)
- Billing: normal committed pricing applies to committed volume; overrun consumption during the window is eligible for either: (A) 30% surcharge on per-token list price, or (B) one-time 70% credit on the overrun invoice if signed PO is received within 5 business days.
- Payment & PO: PO to include deal id RDW-AVY-2027-Q2-089 and the docusign link. Signed PO qualifies for credit path; otherwise surcharge will be billed on next invoice.
- Attachment: simple worked example and the avery-usage-Apr-10.csv we received attached for transparency.

Attached: rescue-term-sheet.pdf, avery-usage-Apr-10.csv (copy), signed-PO-avery-0427.pdf (pending — placeholder until we receive the signed doc).

If everything looks good I’ll drop the term-sheet into the HubSpot deal and send the DocuSign link.

—Laura
